token_help: Same URL: leave blank to reuse the saved token. New URL: enter a token.
hold_help: No sensor update within this time means missing data.
zero_expected_power: PR is not shown when expected power is zero.
current_source_unavailable: A sensor has no recent data.
ha_connection_failed: Cannot reach Home Assistant. Check the URL, token and connection.
connection_required: Configure a Home Assistant connection first.
origin_mismatch: This request came from a different site.
history_unavailable: HA history is unavailable; collecting live data.
source_semantics: Choose sensors and enter panel details.
energy_help: Energy counts only while all three sensors have data.
daily_energy_incomplete: Today's energy is incomplete after a time zone change.
coverage_help: Completeness: share of time when all three sensors have valid data.
history_no_periods: No complete settled periods in this range.
settled_hint: Summary and charts use the same complete settled periods.
totals_help: Settled energy today and since first setup; these totals do not follow the selected range. Today resets in the HA time zone.
forecast_intro: Weather-driven theoretical output · 7 local calendar days · hourly
forecast_help: Open-Meteo weather and a simplified NOCT model. Rated power and temperature coefficient are shared with monitoring.
azimuth_help: Clockwise from north: 0° to less than 360°.
noct_help: Panel datasheet value: above 20°C, up to 80°C. Default reference: 45°C.
location_help: Location and time zone come from the saved Home Assistant connection. Change them in HA.
location_unavailable: HA location is not available yet.
forecast_calendar_help: Seven local calendar days, including all of today. Select a date for hourly details.
forecast_details_help: Hourly model values. Times include UTC offsets; energy is limited to the selected local day.
forecast_fetch_failed: Weather refresh failed. Available cached values retain their original fetch time.
forecast_marker_help: Dashed line: current time. Hourly power is constant within each weather interval.
forecast_status_disabled: Generation forecast is disabled. Enable it in forecast settings.
forecast_status_location_unavailable: HA location is unavailable. Check the saved connection and HA location.
forecast_status_partial: Some weather intervals are missing. Incomplete totals are unavailable.
forecast_status_stale: Showing older weather data. Check the successful fetch time.
forecast_status_unavailable: No usable weather forecast is available. Retry the refresh.
forecast_location_required: A valid HA location is required.
forecast_scroll: Scroll horizontally to see all values. ↔
